note: A bio per card. EVERY rating names the printed field it derives from, in the `why` object — a rating that cannot name one does not ship. A cuteness score I invented would be my taste wearing a number, and our own law says a grouping not in the data is slop.

derivations.comedy: the attack NAME — a genuinely absurd one scores 8, a soft verb scores 5
derivations.artPremium: price against the MEDIAN Illustration Rare of the same set, so set-wide inflation cancels. An IR trading far above its neighbours is one where the artwork carries the value.
derivations.cute: requires BOTH the structural shape of a small creature AND a market premium on the art. Structure alone rates every unwanted 60 HP Basic as cute; premium alone rates Groudon as cute. Neither works by itself.
derivations.serious: grim language in the printed flavour text scores 9; legend framing scores 6
derivations.colour: the TYPE, because the type determines the card's frame colour — not an aesthetic judgement

refused: popularity and likeness. We hold no engagement data per card, and any number would be invented. They ship when there is a real signal behind them and not before.

dp3-1.name: Ampharos
dp3-1.lore: The tip of its tail shines brightly. In the olden days, people sent signals using the tail's light.

dp3-2.name: Blastoise
dp3-2.lore: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.

dp3-3.name: Charizard
dp3-3.lore: It is said that CHARIZARD's fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.

dp3-4.name: Entei
dp3-4.lore: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

dp3-5.name: Flygon
dp3-5.lore: It whips up sandstorms with powerful flaps of its wings. It is known as "The Desert Spirit."

dp3-6.name: Gallade
dp3-6.lore: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.

dp3-7.name: Gardevoir
dp3-7.lore: It will try to guard its trusted Trainer with its life. It has the ability to see the future.

dp3-8.name: Gastrodon East Sea
dp3-8.lore: It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.

dp3-10.name: Ho-Oh
dp3-10.lore: Its feathers are in seven colors. It is said that anyone seeing it is promised eternal happiness.

dp3-11.name: Jumpluff
dp3-11.lore: Blown by seasonal winds, it circles the globe, scattering cotton spores as it goes.

dp3-12.name: Lickilicky
dp3-12.lore: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting to close to it will leave you soaked with drool.

dp3-13.name: Ludicolo
dp3-13.lore: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can't help breaking out into a dance.

dp3-14.name: Lugia
dp3-14.lore: It sleeps in a deep-sea trench. If it flaps its wings, it is said to cause a 40-day storm.

dp3-15.name: Mew
dp3-15.lore: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe MEW to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

why.cute: an unevolved Basic at 60 HP — the shape of a small creature, with no market signal either way

dp3-16.name: Raikou
dp3-16.lore: It is said to have fallen with lightning. It can fire thunderbolts from the rain clouds on its back.

dp3-17.name: Roserade
dp3-17.lore: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.

dp3-18.name: Salamence
dp3-18.lore: As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changes, and wings grew out.

dp3-19.name: Suicune
dp3-19.lore: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.

why.cute: an unevolved Basic at 70 HP — the shape of a small creature, with no market signal either way

dp3-20.name: Venusaur
dp3-20.lore: After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells stronger. The scent attracts other Pokémon.

dp3-21.name: Absol
dp3-21.lore: It senses disasters coming and appears before people only to warn them of impending danger.

why.cute: an unevolved Basic at 70 HP — the shape of a small creature, with no market signal either way

dp3-22.name: Arcanine
dp3-22.lore: Its proud and regal appearance has captured the hearts of people since long ago.

dp3-23.name: Banette
dp3-23.lore: A doll that became a Pokémon over its grudge from being junked. It seeks the child that disowned it.

dp3-24.name: Dugtrio
dp3-24.lore: Its three heads moves alternately, driving it through tough soil to depths of over 60 miles.

dp3-25.name: Electivire
dp3-25.lore: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.

dp3-26.name: Electrode
dp3-26.lore: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.

dp3-27.name: Furret
dp3-27.lore: The mother puts its offspring to sleep by curling up around them. It corners foes with speed.

dp3-28.name: Golduck
dp3-28.lore: A Pokémon that lives in lakes. It swims faster than any human swimming champion.

dp3-29.name: Golem
dp3-29.lore: It sheds its hide once a year. Its boulderlike body is so tough, even dynamite can't harm it.

dp3-30.name: Jynx
dp3-30.lore: It cries sound like human speech. However, it is impossible to tell what it is trying to say.

why.cute: an unevolved Basic at 70 HP — the shape of a small creature, with no market signal either way

dp3-31.name: Magmortar
dp3-31.lore: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.

dp3-32.name: Minun
dp3-32.lore: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.

why.cute: an unevolved Basic at 60 HP — the shape of a small creature, with no market signal either way

dp3-33.name: Mothim
dp3-33.lore: It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by COMBEE.

dp3-34.name: Nidoking
dp3-34.lore: One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone pole as if it were a matchstick.

dp3-35.name: Pidgeot
dp3-35.lore: By flapping its wings with all its might, PIDGEOT can make a gust of wind capable of bending tall trees.

dp3-36.name: Plusle
dp3-36.lore: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.

why.cute: an unevolved Basic at 60 HP — the shape of a small creature, with no market signal either way

dp3-37.name: Sharpedo
dp3-37.lore: Its fangs rip through sheet iron. It swims at 75 mph and is known as "The Bully of the Sea."

dp3-38.name: Sunflora
dp3-38.lore: It gets energy from warm sunlight and is known for its habit of moving in pursuit of it.

dp3-39.name: Unown [S]
dp3-39.lore: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

dp3-40.name: Weavile
dp3-40.lore: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.

dp3-41.name: Wormadam Plant Cloak
dp3-41.lore: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

dp3-44.name: Xatu
dp3-44.lore: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun's movement all day.

dp3-45.name: Breloom
dp3-45.lore: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.

dp3-46.name: Charmeleon
dp3-46.lore: In the rocky mountains where CHARMELEON live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.

dp3-47.name: Cloyster
dp3-47.lore: It fights by keeping its shell tightly shut for protection and by shooting spikes to repel foes.

dp3-48.name: Donphan
dp3-48.lore: It attacks by curling up, then rolling into its foe. It can blow apart a house in one hit.

dp3-49.name: Farfetch'd
dp3-49.lore: It can't live without the stalk it holds. That's why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.

dp3-50.name: Flaaffy
dp3-50.lore: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.

dp3-51.name: Ivysaur
dp3-51.lore: When the bud on its back starts swelling, a sweet aroma wafts to indicate the flower's coming bloom.

dp3-52.name: Kecleon
dp3-52.lore: It can freely change its body's color. The zigzag pattern on its belly doesn't change, however.

dp3-54.lore: It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.

dp3-55.name: Miltank
dp3-55.lore: It is said that kids who drink MILTANK's milk grow up to become hearty, healthy adults.

dp3-56.name: Muk
dp3-56.lore: A toxic fluids seeps from its body. The fluid instantly kills plants and trees on contact.

dp3-57.name: Nidorino
dp3-57.lore: It has a violent disposition and stabs foes with its horn, which oozes poison upon impact.

dp3-58.name: Pidgeotto
dp3-58.lore: It flies over its wide territory in search of prey, downing it with its highly developed claws.

dp3-59.name: Pinsir
dp3-59.lore: It grips prey with its pincers until the prey is torn in half. What it can't tear, it tosses far.

dp3-60.name: Quagsire
dp3-60.lore: It has a sluggish nature. It lies at the river's bottom, waiting for prey to stray into its mouth.

dp3-61.name: Raticate
dp3-61.lore: It whittles its constantly growing fangs by gnawing on hard things. It can chew apart cinder walls.

dp3-62.name: Roselia

dp3-66.name: Smeargle

dp1-1.name: Dialga
dp1-1.lore: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

dp1-2.name: Dusknoir
dp1-2.lore: The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.

dp1-4.name: Empoleon
dp1-4.lore: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.

dp1-5.name: Infernape
dp1-5.lore: It uses a special kind of martial arts involving all its limbs. Its fire never goes out.

dp1-6.name: Lucario
dp1-6.lore: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.

dp1-7.name: Luxray
dp1-7.lore: It has eyes that can see through anything. It spots and captures prey hiding behind objects.

dp1-8.name: Magnezone
dp1-8.lore: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.

dp1-9.name: Manaphy
dp1-9.lore: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.

dp1-10.name: Mismagius
dp1-10.lore: Its cries sound like incantations. Those hearing it are tormented by headaches and hallucinations.

dp1-11.name: Palkia
dp1-11.lore: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

dp1-12.name: Rhyperior
dp1-12.lore: It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. Geodude are shot at rare times.

dp1-14.name: Shiftry
dp1-14.lore: By flapping its leafy fan, it can whip up gusts of 100 ft/second that can level houses.

dp1-15.name: Skuntank
dp1-15.lore: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.

dp1-16.name: Staraptor
dp1-16.lore: It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger.

dp1-17.name: Torterra
dp1-17.lore: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.

dp1-18.name: Azumarill
dp1-18.lore: It lives in rivers and lakes. In water, its coloring and patterns trick the vision of foes.

dp1-19.name: Beautifly
dp1-19.lore: It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its long, narrow mouth to drain the prey's fluids.

dp1-20.name: Bibarel
dp1-20.lore: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

dp1-21.name: Carnivine
dp1-21.lore: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

dp1-22.name: Clefable
dp1-22.lore: Rarely seen by people, it is said to be drawn by the full moon to play at deserted lakes.

dp1-23.name: Drapion
dp1-23.lore: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.

dp1-24.name: Drifblim
dp1-24.lore: It's drowzy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.

dp1-25.name: Dustox
dp1-25.lore: A nocturnal Pokémon. Drawn by streetlights, they messily eat the leaves of trees lining boulevards.

dp1-26.name: Floatzel
dp1-26.lore: It floats using its well-developed floatation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

dp1-27.name: Gengar
dp1-27.lore: It hides in shadows. It is said that if Gengar is hiding, it cools that area by nearly 10 degrees F.

dp1-28.name: Heracross
dp1-28.lore: It gathers in forests to search for tree sap, its favorite food. It's strong enough to hurl foes.

dp1-29.name: Hippowdon
dp1-29.lore: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.

dp1-30.name: Lopunny
dp1-30.lore: An extremely cautious Pokémon. It cloaks its body with its fluffy ear fur when it senses danger.

dp1-31.name: Machamp
dp1-31.lore: It punches with its four arms at blinding speed. It can launch 1,000 punches in two seconds.

dp1-32.name: Medicham
dp1-32.lore: Through yoga training, it has honed its sixth sense. Its movements are elegant.

dp1-33.name: Munchlax
dp1-33.lore: It wolfs down its weight in food once a day, swallowing food whole with almost no chewing.

dp1-35.name: Pachirisu

dp1-38.name: Steelix

dp1-39.name: Vespiquen

dp1-41.name: Wobbuffet
